free_text: I defer biopsy because the mpMRI shows a PI-RADS 3 lesion, which aligns with the guideline criterion for deferral when the picture has not changed. Although the PSA velocity was high (0.97 ng/mL/yr) and the PSA rose from 5.8 ng/mL to 7.4 ng/mL, the explicit guideline criterion strongly favors deferring sampling for an unchanged PI-RADS 3 finding. The statistical prior suggested biopsy, but the retrieved evidence, specifically the PI-RADS 3 finding and the guideline anchor, tipped the decision toward deferral.
